slides.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
slides.subtitle: A Comprehensive Overview
slides.speaker_notes: Welcome to this presentation on Artificial Intelligence. Today we will explore the fundamentals of AI, its applications, and the impact it has on our world.

slides.title: What is Artificial Intelligence?
content: AI is the simulation of human intelligence by machines
Enables computers to learn, reason, and solve problems
Encompasses machine learning, deep learning, and NLP
Powers applications from search engines to autonomous vehicles
slides.speaker_notes: Artificial Intelligence refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines that are programmed to think and learn. It encompasses a wide range of technologies including machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing.

slides.title: AI Technology Landscape
slides.speaker_notes: This diagram shows the breakdown of AI capabilities and their relative importance in modern applications.

slides.title: Key AI Applications
content: Natural Language Processing: chatbots, translation, summarisation
Computer Vision: facial recognition, medical imaging
slides.speaker_notes: AI has numerous practical applications across industries. Natural language processing powers chatbots and translation services. Computer vision enables facial recognition and medical imaging analysis. Robotics drives manufacturing automation and autonomous vehicles.

slides.title: Machine Learning Growth Trend
slides.speaker_notes: The graph illustrates the exponential growth in machine learning model performance over recent years.

slides.title: Future of AI
content: General AI capable of reasoning across domains
AI-human collaboration in creative and analytical tasks
Ethical frameworks guiding responsible AI development
Continued breakthroughs in multimodal AI systems
slides.speaker_notes: The future of AI holds tremendous promise. We anticipate the development of general AI systems capable of reasoning across multiple domains. AI-human collaboration will become increasingly common in both creative and analytical work.

slides.title: Thank You
slides.subtitle: Questions & Discussion
slides.speaker_notes: Thank you for your attention. We hope this presentation has given you a solid understanding of artificial intelligence and its transformative impact. We are now open for questions and discussion.
